title.narrative: Education, Equity and Advocacy: An innovative Project to Influence SRHR policies

description.narrative: The project aims to influence public policy on SRHR by integrating education, gender equity, and advocacy for legislative reforms on abortion access and implementation of comprehensive sexual education (CSE). This initiative seeks to improve the lives of marginalised groups, particularly young people, migrants, refugees, and women, by promoting universal access to quality services, upholding human rights, and addressing gender inequalities.
